ruleDefinitions.name: NetNTLM Downgrade Attack
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects NetNTLM downgrade attack Note: Unmapped fields: ObjectName, ObjectValueName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4657 AND (ObjectName = RGX(".*\\\\REGISTRY\\\\MACHINE\\\\SYSTEM.*") AND ObjectName = RGX(".*ControlSet.*") AND ObjectName = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\Lsa.*")) AND (ObjectValueName = "LmCompatibilityLevel" OR ObjectValueName = "NtlmMinClientSec" OR ObjectValueName = "RestrictSendingNTLMTraffic"))
